feeds.title: Dare To Be Youth Charity Blog
feeds.description: Dare to be Youth Charity (DTBY) is a movement dedicated to empowering high school students and young adults (14-24) in the Halton/Hamilton region and beyond. We believe in the power of community as a key component of thriving and wellness, and we aim to connect youth, facilitate opportunities for dialogue, and help them build the skills to truly thrive. Checkout some of our exciting upcoming events, news, announcements and more!

feeds.title: Compassion Canada Blog
feeds.description: As one of the world's leading child development organizations, Compassion partners with the local church in 25 countries to end poverty in the lives of children and their families. Today, more than two million children are discovering lives full of promise and purpose as they develop in all the different aspects of their lives - physically, emotionally, relationally and spiritually. Browse through our work, charity advice, initiatives and more!

feeds.title: Canada Gives Blog
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date with all that is happening with Canada Gives and creating a foundation with the latest News and Views from our blog. Canada Gives is a registered charity that simplifies and centralizes the process of giving. We're dedicated to help you create lasting change. Canada Gives enables major donors to establish and operate family foundations using DAF structures.

feeds.title: Canadian Centre for Christian Charities Blog
feeds.description: Discover CCCC's blogs for commentary and insights that help inform, support, and resource Christian ministries. Canadian Centre for Christian Charities is the largest association of Christian charities in Canada. It supports charities with ongoing knowledge, training, and services in the areas of leadership, HR, fundraising, governance, finance and advocacy.

feeds.title: Link Charity Canada Inc. Blog
feeds.description: Since 1998, Link Charity has provided the service, tools, education, and guidance that individuals and charities need when it comes to gift giving. Our wide variety of Gifting Options are current, relevant and designed to help both the individual and the charity. Explore more about charity works, philanthropy, how to give charities and more!

feeds.title: Grant Advance Blog
feeds.description: Learn More about Our Funding Solution, Grant Applications and Useful Tips for Securing Funding for Your Non-Profit by Reading Our Latest Blog Posts. Grant Advance introduces the fastest, easiest way to acquire funding for your charity. Our user-friendly platform streamlines the grant writing process in providing users with tools to create industry standard documents, customize letters, apply smart tags, and to efficiently manage funding needs with minimal effort.

feeds.title: Oakville Community Foundation
feeds.description: At The Oakville Community Foundation, we believe that the future strength and prosperity of our community starts with long-term investments made today. Our job is to keep an eye on our community's needs and put resources where they are needed. Keep up with the latest news and updates on events, charities and more!

feeds.title: CharityCAN Blog
feeds.description: CharityCAN indexes several datasets including donation histories, biographies and wealth indicators, enabling you to find all the data you need with a single search. We use machine learning methodologies to group these separate data points into donor profiles and build a relationship graph to reveal connections between prospective donors and your organization. Check out the latest blogs and articles to know more about our work , data and more!

feeds.title: Charity Intelligence Canada
feeds.description: Charity Intelligence ratings and reviews on Canadian charities so donors can be informed, give intelligently, and have an impact. Charity Intelligence researches Canadian charities for donors to be informed and give intelligently. Our website posts free reports on more than 800 Canadian charities, as well as in-depth primers on philanthropic sectors like Canada's environment, cancer, and homelessness.

feeds.title: People First Fundraising Solutions Blog
feeds.description: Sustainable Solutions Blog provides Insights, perspectives and suggestions to enhance the effectiveness and sustainability of your fundraising activities. People First Fundraising Solutions (formerly People First Resource Development) has been helping charities, grassroots groups and municipalities since 2006 in developing sustainable fundraising strategies. These strategies help to safeguard long-term viability of their programs and services.

feeds.title: CNEWA Canada Blog
feeds.description: Across the Middle East, Northeast Africa, India and Eastern Europe, the Catholic Near East Welfare Association (CNEWA) works in places where poverty, war and displacement shatter innocent lives. Know more about the initiatives, help we have provided, drives and more!

feeds.title: Cadence Charity Services Blog
feeds.description: Cadence Charity Services is proudly 100% women-owned and operated, and dedicated to serving our clients thoughtfully and thoroughly. We leverage our more than 40 years of combined experience in the sector to demystify complicated legal and reporting requirements, provide an exceptional records office, and offer friendly and accessible compliance and advisory services. Know more about charities, philanthropy, how-tos and more!

feeds.title: Mills & Mills Blog » Charity Law
feeds.description: Trusted Toronto lawyers since 1884. Mills & Mills LLP is a full-service law firm representing clients in Toronto and throughout Ontario. Get the charity law news, updates, case studies and more!

feeds.title: CAGP Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with the latest gift-planning news, resources and events. CAGP is a national association that inspires and educates the people involved in strategic charitable gift planning. We advocate for a beneficial tax and legislative environment that strengthens philanthropic giving, create a networking environment with like-minded professionals and experts, and provide access to outstanding learning opportunities and professional development.

feeds.title: Daily Bread Food Bank Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1983, Daily Bread Food Bank has grown to become one of Canada's largest food banks. Read more about food bank, food shortage, our work, drives and more!

feeds.title: The Charity Report
feeds.description: Follow the news of the day, highlights of people doing amazing work, and new research that sheds light on the forces driving the sector. The Charity Report is a website providing coverage of charities, and the social issues they are dealing with, showcasing their work within the context they operate, and providing analysis of sector-wide trends.

feeds.title: The Philanthropist Journal
feeds.description: The Philanthropist Journal, a publication of the Agora Foundation, is an online journal for those interested and engaged in the charitable and non-profit sector in Canada. We support the sector through the development and dissemination of rigorous, independent, and practical information, insight, and knowledge. We share engaging stories that build community and instigate discussion, dialogue, and debate.

feeds.title: The Salvation Army
feeds.description: The Salvation Army is an international Christian organization that began its work in Canada in 1882 and has grown to become the largest non-governmental direct provider of social services in the country. The Salvation Army offers practical assistance for children and families, often tending to the basic necessities of life, provides shelter for homeless people and rehabilitation for people who have lost control of their lives to an addiction. Explore the latest initiatives and drives from the organization, collection drives and more!

feeds.title: Baby It's Cold Outside Charity Blog
feeds.description: We are a charitable organization based in Alberta, Canada. We are devoted to helping the homeless through various fundraising events, clothing and essentials drives, and our eventual goal is transitional housing. Stay up to date with the latest announcements, collection drives, events and more!

feeds.title: Breakthrough T1D Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1978, JDRF is the type 1 diabetes charity. We fund research to prevent, treat and cure type 1 diabetes and its complications, and we are the world's largest charitable funder of type 1 diabetes research. Our blog features recent research, tips for better health, treatments and more!

feeds.title: YMCA Blog
feeds.description: Check out YMCA of Greater Toronto Blog for updates and news from the charity that ignites the potential in people. We help individuals and communities lead healthier lives. The YMCA of Greater Toronto is a charity tackling the most critical health and social issues in the GTA. For more than 160 years, we have offered children, teens, young adults and families the opportunity for personal growth, community involvement, and leadership.

feeds.title: Foundation Magazine
feeds.description: Foundation Magazine is the Business & Spirit of Philanthropy. Stay tuned to get the latest news and updates.

feeds.title: Canadian Charity Law Blog
feeds.description: Our Blog provides insights to Charities and Involved professionals with legal and ethical issues. Read the latest news and related policy changes in recent posts. CanadianCharityLaw.ca is a website and blog of the law firm Blumberg Segal LLP that provides legal services and advice to Canadian and international non-profits and registered charities.

feeds.title: Charitable Impact Blog
feeds.description: Get stories, tips, and interviews about charity, fundraising, and how to make your impact. Charitable Impact was created to help you create the change you want to see in the world. They are a public foundation that operates as a donor-advised fund.

feeds.title: CARE Canada
feeds.description: Be inspired by incredible women leading change throughout their homes, communities and the world! Founded in 1945 with the creation of the CARE Package, CARE is a leading humanitarian organization fighting global poverty. CARE places special focus on working alongside women and girls. Equipped with the proper resources, women and girls have the power to lift whole families and entire communities out of poverty.
